text: ATC cleared descents to 6,000 ft, 5,000 ft, 4,000 ft, 3,000 ft and 2,000 ft with turns to heading 120 and heading 300 and speeds of 210 kt, 190 kt and 170 kt, and the pilot flying called for flaps 1, flaps 5, flaps 10 and flaps 15. The pilot monitoring read back each altitude, the pilot flying set each MCP altitude, heading and speed and descended, and the pilot monitoring selected each flap setting. The aircraft left 7,000 ft and leveled at each cleared altitude while flying the assigned speeds and configurations. Crosscheck stayed silent throughout, which was right because every call was set and flown correctly.
